parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description:
Pipeline runtime parameters.  
branchModeBranchs: branches to run in branch mode  
envs: environment variables  
runningBranchs: running branches, with keys as repository URLs  
runningTags: running tags, with keys as repository URLs  
runningPipelineArtifacts: keys are source URLs of flow-type artifacts  
runningAcrArtifacts: keys are source URLs of ACR-type artifacts  
runningPackagesArtifacts: keys are source URLs of package-type artifacts  
comment: run comment

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description:
Pipeline ID. You can obtain it from the pipeline link, such as https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/【PipelineId】/current
